scenarios.prompt: REP: 'To verify the treating Physician and Facility Address, please read off their 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI).'
scenarios.right_reply: REP: 'NPI verified! The physician and facility address match our provider registry.'
scenarios.wrong_reply: REP: 'That 10-digit NPI doesn't match the physician or clinic listed on the claim.'

scenarios.prompt: REP: 'And according to your directory check, is this facility participating as In-Network or Out-of-Network?'

option_pool.text: State that network status doesn't affect billing.

scenarios.right_reply: REP: 'Spot on! We've applied the exact network tier for this facility.'
scenarios.wrong_reply: REP: 'Careful—our directory shows the opposite network participation status for that clinic!'
